name: Serket
description: A self-sustaining bruiser-summoner who burrows underground to dive the farthest enemy, summons 3 scorpions that inherit her full stats, and converts their deaths into AoE explosions with ATK-Down. Her underground survival mechanic permanently increases her max HP on first threshold, making her tankier the longer a fight lasts.

skills.name: Sandborn Swarm
skills.description: Serket dives into the sand and summons 3 scorpions around her. The scorpions inherit 100% of her basic stats, take 200% DMG, and last for 10s.

upgrades.level4: Summoned scorpions can also use Lurking Sting.

skills.name: Lurking Sting
skills.description: Serket locks onto the farthest enemy and burrows to tunnel forward, dealing 150% ATK as DMG to enemies in her path and knocking down surrounding enemies upon emerging.

upgrades.level3: Gains a shield equal to 200% ATK upon emerging.

skills.name: Venom Burst
skills.description: When a summoned scorpion falls or disappears, it self-destructs, dealing DMG equal to 200% ATK to enemies within a 3-meter radius and reducing their ATK by 10% for 10s.

skills.name: Sand Rebirth
skills.description: When her HP drops below 40% for the first time, Serket immediately dives into the sand for 3s and permanently increases her max HP by 30%. While burrowing, she restores HP equal to 60% ATK per sec (Passive).

upgrades.level2: Restores HP equal to 80% ATK per sec while burrowing.
upgrades.level3: When her HP drops below 40% for the first time, Serket immediately dives into the sand for 3s and permanently increases her max HP by 40%.
upgrades.level4: Restores HP equal to 100% ATK per sec while burrowing.

relic.name: Venomous Domain
relic.description: Serket deals DMG equal to 80% ATK to surrounding enemies per sec.

upgrades.level2: When taking DMG exceeding 20% of max HP from a single hit, nullifies that DMG and takes 50% less DMG for the next 3s. CD: 15s.
upgrades.level3: Each summoned scorpion deals DMG equal to 80% ATK to surrounding enemies per sec.
upgrades.level4: When taking DMG exceeding 20% of its max HP from a single hit, summoned scorpions nullify that DMG and take 50% less DMG for the next 3s. CD: 15s.
